svg.text: Forward path through the check ladder, and every class of message that can come back
Each rung may reject; order state is written at every rung
Instrument live · lot · tick · segment enabled
Type, attribute and validity legal on this exchange
Active · not frozen · segment activated · DDPI
Ban period · surveillance measure · broker block
Operating range · Limit Price Protection · broker collar
OI limits · client concentration · hedge offset
More states than the forward path — most defects live here
Exchange reason code — map, do not swallow
Stop-loss released into the regular book
Quantity or value freeze — pending approval
End of session, or exchange action
If an order is sent and the session drops before an acknowledgement
arrives, the firm does not know whether the exchange holds it. That order is
marked unknown — never assumed sent, never assumed lost — and new order
only after reconciliation against the exchange. The client is shown “unknown”, not a guess.
Optimistic resumption is the most expensive failure here: it produces
positions the risk engine is not accounting for, and square-offs on a false book.
